name: Women Entrepreneurship Platform (India)

sources.title: WEP — Government of India (NITI Aayog) Women Entrepreneurship Platform; site resolves (200) but flagged our fetcher's content as 'potentially suspicious'

requirements: Women entrepreneurs in India only — WEP is a NITI Aayog government platform
Registration on the platform gives access to the knowledge bank, community, schemes, and partner services
The knowledge-bank/blog surface exists but content is member-facing; no public 'submit a listing' surface was reachable
wep.gov.in blocked automated content fetch ('suspicious content' notice) — details limited to homepage structure
preparation: Eligibility: a woman founder/entrepreneur operating in India
workflow: Use the knowledge bank, community features, scheme finders
No public product listing is generated — value is resources/community, not exposure
watchFor: Very weak catalog fit — a government support platform, not a launch directory; nothing here produces a public listing or backlink
Demographic + geographic eligibility restricts most submitters
countsAsLive: A registered WEP member account — no public listing is produced
unknowns: Whether any public-facing business directory exists inside
